neighbours.label: A light source being hidden or covered by something in front of it (the disk is hidden by / covered by ...), in optics or astronomy text
fire: Hold a coin at arm's length until the full moon is exactly covered by its rim.
At mid-eclipse the bright disk of the star is partly hidden by the planet crossing in front of it.
She raised her thumb until the street lamp was completely hidden by the nail.
For a few minutes the solar disk is entirely covered by the dark body of the moon.
The observer shifts the screen until the candle flame is just hidden by the edge of the card.
During the transit a small part of the sun's face is covered by the black dot of Venus.
Move the paddle sideways until the laser spot is hidden by the opaque strip.
As the satellite passes, the distant star is briefly covered by its solar panel.
quiet: Hold a coin at arm's length until your elbow is fully straight and steady.
At midnight the old map of the island was secretly hidden by the captain under a loose board.
She raised her thumb until the driver noticed and pulled over to the kerb.
For a few minutes the football pitch is entirely covered by a sheet of hail.
The gardener shifts the pots until the seedlings are just sheltered from the wind.
During the winter a small part of the meadow is covered by drifting snow.
Move the paddle sideways until the canoe turns toward the bank.
As the parade passes, the old statue is briefly decorated with paper flags.
